text:
ConocoPhillips rose 1.6% today, continuing a four-day rally that's brought the stock up $6 from its November 6 low. The timing aligns with a broader pickup in oil prices—US crude is trading around $89.62 a barrel—and follows CNBC naming ConocoPhillips among "the biggest calls of the day" on November 11, likely signaling analyst attention and positive commentary on the energy sector.

The stock's recovery from last week's 7.6% decline suggests traders are looking past near-term supply worries (Russian production rebounding after a Trump diesel deal pushed markets into surplus) and focusing instead on structural tailwinds: heating oil prices up 59% year-over-year signal strong seasonal demand ahead, while persistent energy needs—including data center power demand that utilities say won't slow—underpin longer-term crude consumption.
